design.steps: retrain on what arrived in W1..Wk -> test W(k+1), for k = 1..5
design.buffer: both feeds, earlier windows, timestamp before retraining; anchor feed delayed 45 min
design.gate_off: train on the whole buffer (naive retraining)
design.gate_on: trust gate drops suspect fast-feed pings first; limits learned from W1 only; predictions with a 90% range radius > 1852 m are deferred to a human
design.error_metric_scope: all test predictions, deferred ones included
design.test_data: clean NOMINAL inputs and true positions, identical for all runs
design.poisoning_stage: training-time (retraining buffer); test-time inputs are clean
design.no_future_rule: train rows need their 15-min answer before retraining
design.window_rule: voyage belongs to the window of its first ping
